notes: Samba AD-DC provisioning is enabled for a new primary domain controller
The selected domain interface must use a static IPv4 address
Provisioning requires a one-time local approval code generated with sudo control-center-samba-approve
The Domain Administrator password is passed through /run and is not stored in PostgreSQL or persistent Control Center state
A root-only backup is created before package, resolver, Kerberos or Samba changes
Failed provisioning triggers rollback of Samba, resolver, service and Control Center DHCP state
When Control Center DHCP serves the AD interface, clients are forced to use the AD-DC IP as their only DNS server
Renaming an active DC or changing/disabling its interface/IP is blocked
Automatic domain destruction/removal is intentionally not implemented in 1.0.11
